methods.name: deploy

doc.text:
Deploys application commands, diffing against Discord first.

By default it honours per-command scoping: commands with no `guilds` go
global, commands with `guilds` go to those guilds. Pass `guildId` to instead
force **every** command onto one guild (fast local testing).
examples: await bot.deploy();                    // production: global + per-guild
await bot.deploy({ guildId: devId });  // everything on one guild
await bot.deploy({ dryRun: true });    // preview the plan

symbols.name: loadEnvFile
symbols.text:
Loads a `.env` file into `process.env`. Safe to call when the file is absent.

You rarely need it: the `.env` of the working directory is read as soon as
the package is imported. Call it for another file (`.env.local`, a path of
your own). What the real environment already defines is never replaced; a
file loaded here wins over the `.env` read at import.

Unlike the read at import, it loads every variable of the file, those that
can run code included (`NODE_OPTIONS`, `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED`...):
call it only on a file you trust.
examples: loadEnvFile(".env.local");

symbols.name: DeferOption
symbols.text:
When and how an interaction is acknowledged for you.

- `true` - defer publicly, but only if the handler has not answered after 2 s.
- `"ephemeral"` - the same, with an only-you loading state.
- `"update"` - for components: acknowledge without a loading message, so the
  handler can then edit the source message with `ctx.update(...)`.
- an object - choose the visibility and the delay yourself. `after: 0` defers
  immediately; any duration string (`"1s"`) or number of milliseconds works.
- `false` - never defer automatically.

symbols.name: deployCommands
symbols.text:
Deploys commands, honouring per-command scoping:
 - commands with no `guilds` go **global**,
 - commands with `guilds` go to **those guilds**.

Each target is diffed independently and pushed only if it changed. Pass
`guildId` to instead force every command onto one guild (fast dev testing).
examples:
// Production: global commands globally, scoped commands to their guilds.
const result = await deployCommands(registry, { token, clientId });

// Dev: everything onto one guild, instantly.
await deployCommands(registry, { token, clientId, guildId: devGuildId });

Discord fills in defaults and adds bookkeeping fields, so a field-by-field

fields do not exist at all.
